=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/codex_isolated_workspace.py:73-76, 119-126 | severity=critical | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The credential-path filter allows common private-key and credential files, including `.ssh/id_rsa`, `.npmrc`, and `.netrc`, into the agent snapshot.
  WHY: An injected instruction can direct the agent to read a copied credential and expose it through the host-side model broker; reviewers rated this BLOCKER or MAJOR, with BLOCKER the highest rating.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8665-8669 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `invoke_judge_for_integration_conflict` returns the commit/push helper's status instead of 0 when judge invocation completes.
  WHY: A nonzero helper result is treated by the caller as judge invocation failure, terminalizing integration recovery instead of recording the invocation and allowing another poll tick.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8728-8731 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `_integration_judge_commit_and_push` treats a `git commit` failure caused by “nothing to commit” as a hard error.
  WHY: When the merge is a no-op, the propagated failure can terminalize recovery despite there being no changes to commit; reviewers rated this BLOCKER or MAJOR, with BLOCKER the highest rating.
- tests/test_codex_agent_isolation_contract.py:203 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The contract test asserts that `invoke_judge_for_integration_conflict` returns `"${judge_push_rc}"`, locking in the incorrect return-code propagation.
  WHY: Correcting the function to return 0 after judge invocation will make this assertion fail unless the test is updated.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:249-272 (root) vs. 249-281 (template) in `_shell_segments_with_operators`; 620-622 (root) vs. 644-646 (template) in `git_subcommands` | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The root hook lacks the template's redirection-token handling and `+=` assignment handling.
  WHY: Git push commands with redirections or `+=` assignments can evade parsing and the push guard, and template parity tests fail.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8515-8518 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: A nonzero local merge result with no conflict-marked files makes the function return 1 and prevents the judge from running.
  WHY: A transient non-conflict merge error can block self-healing until a later poll tick; z-ai_glm-5_2 rated this NIT while the other reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py: 18336-18364, 18393-18413 | severity=critical | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The integration-conflict tests do not configure `mock_git_push_success=True` for the new local-merge path.
  WHY: The mocked push fails, causing the invocation to return 1 and the tests to observe the exhausted comment rather than the expected judge-invoked comment.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py (LAST RUN DIFF): 1507-1510 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The review reports that the literal-ID loop carve-out was applied to the root but not the consumer template, while also stating the files currently match and this is not currently a defect.
  WHY: If the template later diverges, consumers could receive older behavior and `tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py::test_template_parity` could fail.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8665-8669 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: `invoke_judge_for_integration_conflict` returns `judge_push_rc` instead of 0 after successful judge invocation.
  WHY: A commit or push failure propagates to the caller, which terminalizes recovery instead of retrying on the next poll tick.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8728-8731 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: `_integration_judge_commit_and_push` returns 1 when `git commit --no-verify -q` fails on a no-op merge with nothing to commit.
  WHY: The propagated failure terminalizes the project even though the branches are already in sync.
- tests/test_codex_agent_isolation_contract.py:203 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The contract test asserts `return "${judge_push_rc}"`, locking in the incorrect return-code propagation.
  WHY: The assertion will fail when the function is corrected to return 0 after judge invocation.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:260-261 (missing redirect_target initialization) and 620-623 (missing += assignment handling) | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The root hook lacks the template's redirect-target handling and handling for `+=` shell variable assignments.
  WHY: Push commands with redirections or `+=` assignments are not properly parsed, and template parity and push-parser tests fail.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8515-8518 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: A nonzero local merge result with zero conflict-marked files makes the function return 1.
  WHY: A transient non-conflict Git error blocks the judge from running until a later poll tick.

TASK_GAP
Requirement: "passes all 4 CI groups" of test_orchestrate_poll_process.py and the two orchestrate gate test files (from PR description)
Expected change site: CI on the branch head ffc3ad80
Evidence of absence: CI run 37196926625 shows orchestrate-poll group 3 failing with test_integration_sync_conflict_uses_sync_specific_retry_budget_default_one (1 failed, 27 passed) and tests-hooks-and-orchestrator failing with 5 failures in test_pr_merge_status_guard.py (5 failed, 171 passed). The poll process test failure is branch-specific and caused by the return-code propagation bug described above. The merge guard test failures were introduced by the merge commit's incomplete conflict resolution.
SEVERITY: BLOCKER
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

- scripts/codex_isolated_workspace.py: lines 75-76 and 122-126 | severity=critical | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: Credential filtering allows common private keys, sensitive configuration files, sensitive directories, and filenames containing “secret” or “credential” to pass.
  WHY: Tracked credentials can be copied into snapshots and exposed through the host model broker after an injected prompt directs the agent to read them.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh: line 8669: return "${judge_push_rc}" | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: `invoke_judge_for_integration_conflict` returns the helper's exit status rather than 0 when judge invocation completes.
  WHY: A helper failure makes the caller mark the project failed instead of recording the invocation and allowing subsequent retries.
- tests/test_codex_agent_isolation_contract.py: line 203: assert 'return "${judge_push_rc}"' in text | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The test asserts the broken return-code propagation.
  WHY: Correcting the function to return 0 will make this contract test fail unless its assertion is updated.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: lines 262-272 and line 621 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The root hook does not skip redirection tokens and its environment-assignment parser does not recognize `+=`.
  WHY: Commands with redirections or `+=` assignments fail to parse correctly, and template parity and push-parser tests fail.

The PR description claimed these groups pass, but branch changes introduced the failure in orchestrate-poll (3) and the merge conflict resolution introduced the failure in tests-hooks-and-orchestrator. Note that Claude engine isolation is explicitly documented under "Residual risks / not in this PR" as deferred to PR #6174 and is therefore not an unmet gap.
